name: Truworths International Limited
summary: Truworths International Limited, an investment holding and management company, engages in the retail of fashion apparel and accessories. It operates through Truworths Africa and Office UK segments. The company offers accessories, bags, bottoms, jackets and coats, jewellery and watches, shoes, sleepwear, tops, and Gifts for women, men and kids. It also provides purses, denim, dresses, lingerie, maternity, formals, and co-ord sets for women; wallets, suiting, and underwears for men; kids multipacks for kids.
